objective: Attack representation complexity and order sensitivity of the exact ROBDD MK_FUTURE survivor while separating semantic congruence from polynomial representation claims.

family.name: EQ_m
family.CNF: For each i: (-x_i OR y_i) AND (x_i OR -y_i)

frozen_orders.DISCOVERED_PAIR_ORDER: deterministically recover equivalence pairs from the CNF clause set and interleave them in increasing x index

symbolic_obligation.grouped_lower_bound: After all x variables are read under GROUPED_NUMERIC, each alpha in {0,1}^m leaves a distinct residual future requiring y=alpha. Therefore there are at least 2^m pairwise distinct residual Boolean functions at the cut, so any exact OBDD respecting that order has at least 2^m distinct frontier states/nodes. Since EQ_m CNF size is O(m), fixed grouped-order ROBDD size is exponential in input size.
symbolic_obligation.scope: Refutes only the fixed grouped/numeric ROBDD representation as a universal polynomial future interface; it does not refute order-aware ROBDD or other future-interface languages.
symbolic_obligation.congruence_note: ASSIGN and EXISTS congruence of ROBDD remains semantically valid independent of size; R1 separates correctness from representation complexity.

gates.G1_SMALL_M_SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE: For m<=6, grouped and interleaved BDDs agree with exhaustive truth evaluation of EQ_m.
gates.G2_GROUPED_EXPONENTIAL_SIGNATURE: For every frozen m, grouped reachable-node count matches 3*2^m-3; at m=14 grouped/interleaved ratio exceeds 1000.
gates.G3_INTERLEAVED_LINEAR_SIGNATURE: For every frozen m, interleaved reachable-node count matches 3m.
gates.G4_PAIR_ORDER_DISCOVERY: Deterministic clause-pair detector recovers all m equivalence pairs and emits the interleaved order without truth-table/oracle access.
gates.G5_SYMBOLIC_LOWER_BOUND_RECEIPT: Emit the residual-function lower-bound argument and verify its premises against the frozen EQ_m syntax.
gates.G6_R0_CONGRUENCE_NOT_REVOKED: R1 representation blow-up may refute polynomiality of an order but must not be mislabeled as a semantic collision.
gates.G7_SCIENTIFIC_BOUNDARY: No claim that all orders admit polynomial OBDDs, that a good order is always polynomially discoverable, or that P=NP.

lineage_hypothesis: This test may reproduce the earlier JANUS C022 OBDD order-sensitivity barrier; if so it must be logged as a rediscovered barrier rather than independent novelty.
